A note from my heart

To my love,

Happy birthday to the woman who has loved me through four years of becoming.

When I look at the person I was when we began and the person I am today, I see your love throughout that journey. You stood beside me, believed in me, and gave me strength on the days I struggled to find it myself.

You never tried to turn me into somebody else. You helped me discover the better version of who I already was. Your love became my calm, my courage, and the quiet voice reminding me that I could keep going.

I am proud of what we have built together, and even more grateful for the way you helped me build myself. Whatever comes next, I want to keep growing, laughing, dreaming, and creating a beautiful life beside you.

Four years down, and I still feel lucky that our story is only beginning.

With all my love,
Tanzil
